title: Onboarding Telemetry Dashboards (Mock v0) — Funnel + Telemetry Health
content:
Slide 1 — Title
Onboarding Telemetry Dashboards (Mock v0)
Funnel + Telemetry Health

Audience: PM (Hosted API/Console), DevEx, Console Eng, SRE/Observability
Owner: Observability (Mei) + Telemetry (Nadia)
Last updated: 2026-02-20


Slide 2 — Why these dashboards exist
Goals
- Measure: signup → first success → first production launch (definition in PRD)
- Identify: step drop-off, time sinks, cohort differences
- Monitor: telemetry pipeline correctness + regressions during beta/GA

Non-goals (for v0)
- Perfect attribution across marketing sources
- Full Dedicated/Private funnel coverage (Phase 1 = Hosted API only)


Slide 3 — Global dashboard conventions (applies to all tabs)
Global filters (top bar)
- Time range (default: last 14 days; compare to previous period toggle)
- Deployment mode: Hosted API (default), Dedicated (hidden v0), Private (hidden v0)
- Environment: prod | test | unknown (default: all; show warning if unknown > 5%)
- Cohort: feature_flag_onboarding_checklist = on | off (default: on for beta view)
- Org type: self-serve | sales-assisted (heuristic: contract metadata; v0 optional)
- Region: request_region (default: all)

Standard breakdown dimensions (right-side “Break down by” dropdown)
- SDK language: python | typescript | go | other | unknown
- SDK version (bucketed): <1 minor behind, 1–2 behind, 3+ behind
- Request region: us-east | us-west | eu-central | apac-* | unknown
- Console surface: checklist | api-keys | usage-dashboard | settings | docs-linkout
- Acquisition source (best-effort): console_direct | docs | quickstart | unknown
- Plan/tier (Hosted API): free | paid | enterprise (if known)
- Project count per org: 1 | 2–3 | 4+

Notes
- All charts must support “view underlying events” for a sampled set of rows (privacy-safe fields only).
- All charts must show metric definition tooltips + freshness timestamp.


Slide 4 — Tab layout (proposed)
Tab A: Funnel Overview
Tab B: Step Completion + Time-to-Step
Tab C: Drop-off Diagnostics (errors, rate limits, streaming)
Tab D: Telemetry Health (pipeline + missing events)
Tab E: Beta Cohort Monitoring (feature flag + experiment view)


Slide 5 — Tab A: Funnel Overview (executive summary)
Top KPI tiles (big numbers)
- New orgs (count)
- New projects created (count)
- % with API key created (within 24h of signup)
- % with first successful request (within 24h)
- Median time to first successful request (TTFS)
- % reaching “first production launch” (within 14d)

Primary funnel (stacked step funnel)
Step definitions (names match checklist step ids)
1) org_signed_up
2) api_key_created (any)
3) first_successful_request
4) first_streaming_session
5) usage_dashboard_visited
6) prod_mode_key_created
7) first_production_launch (composite; see slide 8)

Funnel chart requirements
- Show conversion % between steps + cumulative
- Hover shows denominator definition and N
- Toggle: “within X days of signup” (X = 1, 3, 7, 14)
- Toggle: per-org vs per-project counting (default: per-org for signup funnel)


Slide 6 — Tab A: Trend view + segmentation
Line charts (daily)
- TTFS p50/p75/p90 (minutes)
- First streaming session rate (% of orgs reaching within 7d)
- Production launch rate (% within 14d)

Segment cards (small multiples)
- By SDK language
- By request region
- By plan/tier
- By checklist enabled vs disabled

Callout annotations
- Deploy markers (Console release train / backend deploy) overlay
- “Telemetry incident” markers from on-call notes (manual v0)


Slide 7 — Tab B: Step Completion table (operational view)
Table: Checklist steps
Columns
- Step name
- % started (event seen)
- % completed
- Median time from signup to completion
- p90 time from signup to completion
- Biggest drop-off segment (auto: highest variance by breakdown dimension)
- “Top support issue tag” (manual mapping v0; later: from ticket tags)

Row ordering
- Default: in checklist order
- Alternate: sort by drop-off (% started - % completed)

Inline notes
- Each row links to relevant docs URL and Console deep link (for PM/DevEx triage)


Slide 8 — Definition card: “First production launch” (composite metric)
We need a stable definition for dashboards even if checklist copy changes.

Proposed v0 composite (per project)
A project is “first_production_launch = true” when ALL are true within a rolling 14-day window:
- prod_mode_key_created = true (or api_key_labeled_prod)
- first_successful_request = true using prod key (if key context is available)
- error_rate (5xx + gateway_timeouts) below threshold for 24h (v0 optional; may be noisy)
- usage_dashboard_visited = true OR telemetry_event “observability_config_viewed” = true

Notes / caveats
- “Production” is user intent + safeguards; telemetry can only approximate.
- v0 should expose a “definition version” label (prod_launch_def_v0) for back-compat.


Slide 9 — Tab B: Time-between-steps (where time is spent)
Visual: Sankey / step-to-step latency histogram

Metrics
- Time from api_key_created → first_successful_request
- Time from first_successful_request → first_streaming_session
- Time from first_successful_request → prod_mode_key_created
- Time from prod_mode_key_created → first_production_launch

Requirements
- Show distribution (p50/p75/p90) not just averages
- Ability to filter to orgs that eventually reached production (to avoid censoring bias)
- Separate “new orgs” vs “existing orgs exposed to checklist” (beta cohorts)


Slide 10 — Tab C: Drop-off Diagnostics (errors + rate limits + streaming)
Goal: explain why a step is not completing.

Panel 1: First request failure reasons (top categories)
- 401 unauthorized (wrong key / wrong environment)
- 403 forbidden
- 404 model not found / wrong endpoint
- 408/499 timeout / client disconnect
- 429 rate limit / quota
- 5xx server errors

Panel 2: 429 deep dive
- 429 rate over time
- Breakdown: by org, by project, by SDK language
- Link-out: quota settings + docs

Panel 3: Streaming stability
- Streaming sessions started
- Streaming sessions with client disconnect within <10s
- Retry attempts observed (if client emits retry metadata; v0 best-effort)
- Breakdown: by region + SDK

Panel 4: Docs link-outs (proxy for confusion)
- Click-through count from checklist steps to docs
- “Back to Console” return rate (if we can track)


Slide 11 — Tab D: Telemetry Health (pipeline correctness)
Top KPI tiles
- Event ingestion delay p50/p95 (minutes)
- % events dropped by allowlist/redaction
- % events missing required properties
- Dedupe rate (% events with duplicate dedupe_key)
- “Unknown identity” rate (missing org_id/project_id)

Freshness / completeness time series
- Event volume by event_name (stacked area)
- Ingestion delay by region
- Missing required property rate over time

Golden signals by event_name (per 15 min)
- expected_volume baseline band (from last 7d) + anomaly flag
- late_events (arrived > 30 min)


Slide 12 — Tab D: Required properties + privacy guardrails (what we can show)
Required properties (v0)
- event_name
- occurred_at (client or server time)
- received_at (server time)
- org_id (hashed OK for some views; raw internal ok)
- project_id (same as above)
- user_id (internal) OR anonymous_id (if not logged in)
- request_region
- surface (console/backend/sdk)
- sdk_language (if from SDK)
- sdk_version (if from SDK)

Explicitly NOT collected / NOT displayed
- Prompt content
- Model outputs
- Customer-provided headers (except request_id if generated by Redwood)

Dashboard UI requirements
- “Privacy safe” badge + link to review doc
- Hide raw event payload by default; require elevated role to access sampled event inspection


Slide 13 — Tab E: Beta Cohort Monitoring (feature flag rollout)
Cohort view
- Exposure count: orgs with checklist flag ON
- Activation: % of exposed orgs that open checklist at least once
- Completion: % that complete step 1/2/3 within 24h / 7d
- Comparison: exposed vs unexposed (controls)

Guardrail metrics
- Console performance (page load p95 for checklist view)
- Error rate for checklist API endpoints
- Telemetry regressions (missing events) by region

Rollout controls callout
- Show current rollout config: allowlist size, % rollout, “new orgs only” toggle
- Show last config change timestamp + who changed (from admin audit log; v0 placeholder)


Slide 14 — Drill-down experience (common to all tabs)
Drill-down modal: “Investigate cohort”
Inputs
- Select segment (e.g., SDK=python, region=eu-central)

Outputs
- Top failing step
- Top error category
- Links
  - Related Linear issues (manual mapping v0)
  - Runbooks (telemetry incident, checklist feature flag rollback)
  - Support macros / troubleshooting doc

Export
- CSV export for aggregated table
- Shareable link with filters encoded


Slide 15 — Data sources (implementation notes for eng; keep in appendix)
Sources
- Console events (client): checklist_opened, step_cta_clicked, usage_dashboard_visited
- Backend events (server): api_key_created, prod_key_labeled, first_successful_request validator, streaming_session validator
- Gateway metrics/logs: 401/429/5xx rates; request success counts
- Feature flag service: exposure events (who got the flag)

Identity joining
- Prefer org_id + project_id as primary keys
- user_id used only for Console UX analysis; avoid cross-product identity if not needed

Known pitfalls
- Validation lag: first_successful_request may be delayed (metrics aggregation window)
- Multi-project orgs: per-org funnels can overcount “done” if any project succeeds
- SDK events may not be emitted for raw REST users (unknown sdk_language)


Slide 16 — Open questions / decisions needed
Metric definitions
- Do we define TTFS as first 2xx response OR first non-trivial response (token count > 0)?
- What counts as “first streaming session” (min duration? min tokens?)

Breakdown dimensions
- Do we need cloud provider / POP dimension for region debugging (SRE request)?
- How do we represent “framework” (LangChain, etc.) without collecting sensitive info?

Operational
- Who owns dashboard on-call when a telemetry anomaly is detected?
- What is the acceptable missing-event rate before we page? (proposal: >3% for 30 min)


Slide 17 — Next steps (v0 → v1)
v0 (beta)
- Build Funnel Overview + Telemetry Health with minimal drill-down
- Add deploy annotations + basic anomaly alerts

v1 (GA)
- Add robust “production launch” composite with versioning
- Add deeper drop-off diagnostics linking to docs + support issues
- Add retention correlation view (activation → 7d usage)

Owners
- Mei: dashboard build + definitions docstrings
- Nadia: event completeness + required property validation
- Logan: alerting thresholds + telemetry SLOs
